rationale: The confidential-former-name case qualifies the court-document content requirement. Preserve the separate current/former-name application duty and the scoped permission to request additional evidence.

replacements.summary: The court-document requirement to list the former name has an exception when the former name is made confidential in the court order.
replacements.quote: EXCEPTION: You may receive a court order in which the applicant's former name is made confidential (e.g., California's Safe at Home program).
replacements.scope_text: When a court order makes the applicant's former name confidential.
scope_quotes: EXCEPTION: You may receive a court order in which the applicant's former name is made confidential (e.g., California's Safe at Home program).
applies_to: The court order or decree must list both the applicant's current and former name(s).
